verdict.rationale: Fivetran syncs data into the customer's own warehouse or data lake, and can write to data lakes in open table formats. The synced data therefore already sits in storage the user controls, and dbt-based transformation models can be imported into the user's own dbt project. However, open formats are documented only for data-lake destinations, and nothing documents exporting pipeline and connector configurations to leave the platform; the REST API and MCP connection-copying only imply this within Fivetran. missing for 10: explicit export/offboarding documentation for connector configs and metadata, open-format guarantees for non-lake destinations, independent or hands-on corroboration of migrating away.
